memberdef.name: addPolynomial

briefdescription.para: Baseline PolynomialHeap implementation that simply accumulates the pending sum in a single Poly and walks it with an iterator.

detaileddescription.para: No queue, no deduplication: every addPolynomial does a FreeAlgebra::add of the new terms into the running value, and removeLeadTerm just advances the iterator. Useful as a correctness oracle for the geobucket-, map-, and priority-queue-backed heaps defined later in this file.
